data.narrative:
Lumafield is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $142M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparison set of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector at similar or adjacent stages. Key private comparables include Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Hadrian ($1.6B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods apply to this stage and sector. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $10M total-raised proxy and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, yields an implied valuation of $17M. Peer-median analysis across the 7-company same-sector, same/adjacent-stage universe produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The substantial divergence between these methods reflects the wide dispersion typical in early-stage frontier tech, where peer valuations have inflated considerably above traditional capital-based progression models.

Triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $14M to $1.9B, with a median of $834M. The peer-median method dominates given the robustness of the comparable set, though the stage-progression result remains a conservative floor. Key uncertainties include Lumafield's relative technology maturity, commercial traction versus peer reference points, and sector multiple compression risk in current market conditions.
